name: floop-devvit
description: floop — Devvit Web + Mod Tool app for discovering newly created and hottest 90-day subreddits with automated daily email digests.

scripts.dev: npm run build && npx devvit playtest
scripts.build:client: esbuild src/client/main.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --minify --outfile=dist/client/main.js --sourcemap && cp src/client/index.html src/client/styles.css dist/client/
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.check:config: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import { parseAppConfig } from '@devvit/shared-types/schemas/config-file.v1.js'; const cfg = parseAppConfig(fs.readFileSync('devvit.json', 'utf8'), true); console.log('Valid devvit.json:', cfg.name);"
scripts.upload: npm run build && npx devvit upload
scripts.launch: npm run build && npx devvit publish
